connector.name: Web Researcher MCP
connector.registryDescription: Your AI research assistant that cites real sources and stays honest
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image web-researcher-mcp:1.46.0. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the zoharbabin account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SEARCH_PROVIDER
env.description: Search provider: google, brave, serper, searxng, searchapi, duckduckgo, tavily, exa, or hackernews

env.name: SEARCH_ROUTING
env.description: Use multiple search engines with automatic switching if one goes down (e.g. brave,google,serper)

env.name: EXA_API_KEY
env.description: Exa API key (neural/semantic web search provider)

env.name: EDGAR_CONTACT_EMAIL
env.description: Contact email for SEC EDGAR (enables filing_search); falls back to OPENALEX_EMAIL

env.name: COURTLISTENER_API_TOKEN
env.description: CourtListener API token (legal_search works without it; a token raises the rate limit)

env.name: FRED_API_KEY
env.description: FRED API key (enables econ_search for Federal Reserve economic data)
